subjectTemplate: Someone tried to register with your IFPA Footbag email
bodyTemplate:
Someone just tried to create an IFPA Footbag account with this email address, which already has an account.

If this was you, there is no need to register again. Open your browser, go to footbag.org yourself, and choose Login. If you have forgotten your password, choose "Forgot your password?" on the login page.

If this was not you, no action is needed and your account is unchanged.

IFPA will never send you a link to sign in. If an email asks you to click a link to log in to footbag.org, it did not come from us.
